title: Repair Estimates & Appointments — Appointment Window and Arrival Schedule by Estimate Type
content:
Each estimate type offered under Repair Estimates & Appointments sets its own booking window, appointment length and arrival allowance. The figures below are the values in force for every estimate type.

## Schedule

| Estimate type | Minimum lead (calendar days) | Maximum horizon (calendar days) | Same-day booking | Saturday/Sunday appointments | Reserved time (minutes) | Arrival grace (minutes) | Evening-before key drop |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Photo Estimate | 0 | 14 | Yes | Yes | 0 | 0 | No |
| Drive-In Estimate | 0 | 7 | Yes | Yes | 30 | 120 | Yes |
| Scheduled Estimate | 1 | 30 | No | Yes | 45 | 30 | Yes |
| Mobile Estimate | 2 | 21 | No | No | 60 | 15 | No |
| Blueprint Teardown Estimate | 1 | 30 | No | No | 240 | 30 | Yes |
| Structural Blueprint Estimate | 2 | 30 | No | No | 360 | 30 | Yes |

## What each column means

- **Minimum lead** — the minimum number of calendar days between the booking request and the appointment date.
- **Maximum horizon** — the furthest an appointment may be booked ahead of the request, in calendar days.
- **Same-day booking** — whether an appointment may be booked for the same calendar day as the request.
- **Saturday/Sunday appointments** — whether a Saturday or Sunday appointment date may be booked.
- **Reserved time** — the bay or estimator time reserved for the appointment, in minutes; 0 means there is no visit.
- **Arrival grace** — the minutes after the appointment start within which the vehicle may still be checked in before the booking becomes a no-show; 0 means not applicable.
- **Evening-before key drop** — whether the vehicle may be left in the key drop the evening before the appointment, counting as arrival at the appointment start.

## Reading the schedule

- A Photo Estimate shows 0 minutes of reserved time and 0 minutes of arrival grace: it has no visit.
- Saturday or Sunday appointment dates are closed for the Mobile Estimate, the Blueprint Teardown Estimate and the Structural Blueprint Estimate, and open for the other three types.
- Hypothetical reading: for a Scheduled Estimate the table gives a minimum lead of 1 day and a horizon of 30 days, so a request made on a given day can carry an appointment date from the next calendar day up to 30 calendar days out, subject to the same-day and weekend columns.
